description: Tutorial lesson T4 (Dakka Time), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t4_shoot fixture -> select the Boyz as shooter by clicking their token on the board (weapons auto-assign to the only visible target) -> Confirm (3 weapons) -> Fast Roll All in the resolution dock -> Done on each defender save results card (tolerant: pressed only while visible) -> Complete Shooting -> end the phase with the big phase button -> lesson summary -> back to menu.

steps.comment: a Boyz model - board-token path selects the unit as shooter
step 3 must NAME the Confirm button as the thing to press, and say it BEFORE the re-aim fallback - the old copy buried 'Den hit Confirm' at the end and players did not know what was wanted
auto-assign count is timing-dependent (2 or 3 weapons) so the label text is not stable - use the named node
defender save results card 1 - press Done only while visible
defender save results card 2 (tolerant no-op when absent)
defender save results card 3 (tolerant no-op when absent)
press Complete Shooting when the dock offers it; else clear any straggler Done card
second chance Complete Shooting after a late Done card
the phase summary is an embedded modal AcceptDialog mounted on /root (Main.gd:11318) - confirm via emit
